messages:
Maya: Quick non-work poll  whats your go-to comfort food after a stressful deploy? Im assembling a menu of weekend treats. 
Jordan: Ramen. Always ramen. 10 mins, add an egg. :ramen: 
Sam: Grilled cheese + tomato soup. Classic. Toast the bread in butter. :bread: :tomato: 
Alex: Curry (coconut milk vibes). Leftovers are better. Naan in a pan = game changer. :curry: 
Pat: Cold pizza + black coffee. Acceptable and efficient. :pizza: :coffee: 
Nina: Ice cream straight from the tub. Rocky road if Im fancy. :ice_cream: 
Leo: Dumplings pan-fried then steamed. Or pho if Im feeling heroic. :dumpling: 
Maya: Ooh dumpling/pho combo sounds amazing. 
Jordan: Also curious  fastest comfort meal at 11pm when youre wiped? 
Sam: Microwave baked potato, butter, cheese, hot sauce. 10 minutes tops. 
Alex: Eggs frantically cooked in anything. Scrambled + sriracha is my fallback. 
Pat: PB + banana on toast. Childhood-approved. :banana: 
Nina: Dessert wins every time. Ice cream or cookies. 
Maya: poll-bot: "Comfort food showdown" Options: 1 Pizza, 2 Ramen, 3 Curry, 4 Dessert. React with :one: :two: :three: or :four: to vote. Poll open 30m. 
Jordan: :two: 
Maya: :one: 
Sam: :one: 
Alex: :three: 
Pat: :one: 
Nina: :four: 
Leo: :two: 
Maya: Thanks all  Ill try a ramen-mac hybrid and report back with a pic. :camera_with_flash:
